decisive_spans.text: bilateral naevus flammeus along the ophthalmic and maxillary divisions of the trigeminal nerve

response.rationale: The presence of bilateral naevus flammeus and ocular findings strongly supports Phakomatosis pigmentovascularis. While glaucoma is also supported by increased IOP and trabecular hyperpigmentation, the naevus flammeus is a key feature of phakomatosis.
